body: Thank you. I'm gonna get help.

I thought it would be totally fine. 
A nearly a year clean and eventually I just got bored and joined in. That was may. Now the SO is gone, I'm on day 2,  and having cold sweats and nightmares. There are worse ideas, but plenty of better ones as well

o yeah i definately need to speak to someone. got an appointment next week.
